title.zh: 授权向八打雁省贷款四千五百比索（菲律宾货币），并授权该省省议会将该笔款项转贷给省内各市镇，专用于支付该等市镇描笼涯公立学校所聘教师薪资，不得挪作他用的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LOAN OF FOUR THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS, AND AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF SAID PROVINCE TO RELOAN THAT SUM TO SUCH MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PROVINCE AS TO THE PROVINCIAL BOARD MAY SEEM PROPER, TO BE USED IN THE PAYMENT OF SALARIES OF TEACHERS EMPLOYED IN THE BARRIO PUBLIC SCHOOLS OF SUCH MUNICIPALITIES, AND FOR NO OTHER PURPOSE.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE LOAN OF FOUR THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED PESOS, PHILIPPINE CURRENCY, TO THE PROVINCE OF BATANGAS, AND AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF SAID PROVINCE TO RELOAN THAT SUM TO SUCH MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PROVINCE AS TO THE PROVINCIAL BOARD MAY SEEM PROPER, TO BE USED IN THE PAYMENT OF SALARIES OF TEACHERS EMPLOYED IN THE BARRIO PUBLIC SCHOOLS OF SUCH MUNICIPALITIES, AND FOR NO OTHER PURPOSE.
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép vay bốn nghìn năm trăm peso Philippines cho Tỉnh Batangas và ủy quyền cho Hội đồng Tỉnh của tỉnh này cho vay lại khoản tiền đó cho các Thị trấn trong tỉnh theo quyết định phù hợp của Hội đồng Tỉnh, để chi trả lương giáo viên làm việc tại các Trường Tiểu học Barangay của các Thị trấn đó và không sử dụng vào mục đích nào khác
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้อำนาจกู้ยืมสี่พันห้าร้อยเปโซฟิลิปปินส์ให้แก่จังหวัดบาตังกัสและให้อำนาจสภาจังหวัดของจังหวัดดังกล่าวให้กู้ยืมย้อนกลับจำนวนเงินนั้นแก่เทศบาลต่างๆในจังหวัดตามที่สภาจังหวัดเห็นสมควรเพื่อนำไปใช้ชำระเงินเดือนครูที่จ้างไว้ในโรงเรียนประชาชนบารังไกย์ของเทศบาลเหล่านั้นและไม่มีวัตถุประสงค์อื่นใด
title.id: Undang-Undang mengizinkan pinjaman empat ribu lima ratus peso Filipina untuk Provinsi Batangas dan memberi wewenang kepada Dewan Provinsi provinsi tersebut untuk meminjamkan kembali jumlah tersebut kepada kota-kota di provinsi itu sebagaimana dipandang tepat oleh Dewan Provinsi, guna digunakan untuk pembayaran gaji guru yang dipekerjakan di sekolah-sekolah publik barangay kota-kota tersebut dan tidak untuk tujuan lain
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa pinjaman empat ribu lima ratus peso Filipina kepada Wilayah Batangas dan memberi kuasa kepada Lembaga Wilayah wilayah tersebut untuk meminang semula jumlah itu kepada perbandaran-perbandaran dalam wilayah itu sebagaimana dipandang sesuai oleh Lembaga Wilayah untuk digunakan bagi pembayaran gaji guru yang diambil bekerja di sekolah-sekolah awam barangay perbandaran-perbandaran tersebut dan bukan untuk tujuan lain

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of four thousand five hundred pesos. Philippine currency, to be loaned to the Province of Batangas.

The money appropriated in section one of this Act shall be paid by the Insular Treasurer to the
treasurer of the Province of Batangas on the presentation to the Insular Treasurer of a certified copy of a
resolution of the provincial board of Batangas accepting such loan and agreeing to repay the same, without
interest, as follows: Two thousand five hundred pesos, Philippine currency, within two years from the date of
the acceptance of the loan, and one thousand pesos, Philippine currency, each year thereafter until the full
amount of the loan has been repaid to the Insular Treasury.

The provincial board of Batangas is hereby authorized to reloan the money thus made available to
such municipalities in the province as to it may seem proper, to be used by such municipalities in the
payment of teachers employed in their barrio public schools, and for no other purpose, and such loans shall
be repaid by the municipalities to the province, without interest, within such time as may be fixed by the
provincial board.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 10, 1904.
